frequency_question: How often does a substantive decision to tighten capital buffers successfully result in an official announcement meeting exact written criteria within the deadline?
membership_rule: Members are established policy deliberation cycles where capital requirements were actively considered for tightening. Excluded are informal speeches, staff working papers, and announcements outside the formal policy release mechanism.

cases.name: New Zealand RBNZ Capital Requirements Finalization 2019

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 6 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 6 named; representative of modern macroprudential framework utilization in transparent central banking regimes.
known_gaps: Does not exhaustively cover every smaller emerging market central bank, but G10 institutional practice is the appropriate comparator.
skeleton: Total historical major economy countercyclical buffer tightening actions matching formal announcement criteria divided by total formal policy meeting windows where such a change was formally enacted.
multiplier: 6 hits out of 6 substantive tightening actions that reached the official release stage in the surveyed G10 economies.
validity_reason: Central bank communication protocols and formal press release mechanisms change slowly over multi-year horizons.
